say:3:1141104001:1.text: Soren, I'm not sure how you're feeling, but this Sunseek Arena is nothing like what I imagined.
say:3:1141104001:1.source_cn: 不知道索恩有没有这种感觉，残阳武斗场跟我想象中的不太一样。

say:5:1141104003:1.text: Mikola! Could you please tell us the history of the arena?
say:5:1141104003:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉！能和我讲讲武斗场的历史吗？

say:6:1141104004:1.text: The Sunseek Arena we see today is a far cry from what it once was.
say:6:1141104004:1.source_cn: 其实，现在的残阳武斗场和之前已经不太一样了。

choice_prompt:7:1141104004.text: The Sunseek Arena we see today is a far cry from what it once was.
choice_prompt:7:1141104004.source_cn: 其实，现在的残阳武斗场和之前已经不太一样了。

say:8:1141104005:1.text: Originally, it was built to train warriors in teamwork—unity was the goal.
say:8:1141104005:1.source_cn: 最早的残阳武斗场是为了训练战士们的协作能力建立的，团结...

say:9:1141104006:1.text: Winning has always been the name of the game, but things have shifted over the years.
say:9:1141104006:1.source_cn: 虽然规则从来都是胜者为王，但这些看似什么都没变，但又好...

say:10:1141104007:1.text: The crowd's louder than ever, and the contestants have a stronger desire for victory than ever.
say:10:1141104007:1.source_cn: 留下来的只有呼声越来越高的观众，和胜负欲越来越强的选手。

say:12:1141104008:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your arrival has got me thinking again.
say:12:1141104008:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your arrival has got me thinking again.
say:12:1141104008:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your arrival has got me thinking again.

say:13:1141104009:1.text: Until that distance between people fades, it's hard to shake off all the distractions or fully trust each other.
say:13:1141104009:1.source_cn: 只要隔阂存在，就没办法让他们抛开杂念做到完全信任。

say:14:1141104010:1.text: The Warsong Festival's a tournament, not a battlefield! Maybe I've found a new path...
say:14:1141104010:1.source_cn: 这也是战歌节一直倡导的理念，要竞技而非斗争！我或许找到...
